start_definition: First recorded review clock sample after the initial brief/evidence read.

spec_compliance.summary: All six exact slugs, twelve native files, twelve 768px final previews and required evidence are present. Large/half dimensions, doubled cell scale, common palette, exact saved-grid reduction and paired render settings meet the brief.

visual_technical_quality.summary: All twelve final previews directly inspected. Models remain distinct at half resolution and functional openings remain readable. All twelve saved native models independently form one six-neighbor connected assembly; 48 feature probes pass.

known_limits.detail: The common camera partly occludes the upper-right mug; its cavity is covered by the saved-native probe, not an additional view.
Thin decorative oak top seams disappear at half size. This documented simplification does not close a functional opening.
Single-view inspection and integer face connectivity do not establish mechanical strength or animation behavior; these static colored voxel models do not claim either.

The target source-to-authored roundtrip claim was read in its validated evidence, not rerun. This review independently checked saved-native reduction, palette, dimensions/scales, supports, probe volumes, images and hashes without executing target code.
